<entry id="P01192">
<head-word>עֵקֶל</head-word>
<head-word>עִקָּל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>)
<pos> m.</pos> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a bale of loose texture containing the olive pulp to be pressed.</italic></definition>
<notes> Maasr. I, 7; Tosef. ib. I, 7 (Var. עוקל). Toh. X, 8; Y. Ab. Zar. V, end, 45
<sup>b</sup> הע' של נצרים, v. infra. Sabb. 144
<sup>b</sup> מוחל היוצא מע' בית הבד Ar. (ed. מעיקול) the watery fluid which oozes out of the bale made up for the press; (Tosef. Toh. X, 3 מעיקת; R. S. to Toh. IX, 1 מן שוקת, corr. acc.). Tosef. l. c. כינסו ועשאו עיקל (R. S. l. c. שוקת) if he collected the fluid and put it back into the bale. Snh. 26
<sup>a</sup> יכול לומר לע' בית הבד וכ' he (who trims vines in the Sabbatical year) may say, I need the twigs to make a bale for the press. Ib. (proverbial expression) הלב יודע אם לע' אם לעקלקלות the heart knows whether it is done for 
<italic>ʿekel</italic> (a legitimate purpose) or out of 
<italic>‘ã</italic>
<italic>ḳalḳaloth</italic> (perverseness); Y. Shebi. IV, 35
<sup>a</sup>; Lam. R. to I, 5; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲקָלִים, עֲקָלִין</plural-form> (or עִקָּ'). Y. Shebi. l. c. (in Chald. dict.) לע' אנא בעי I need the twigs for &c., v. supra. Ab. Zar. 75
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 3 הע' של נצרין וכ' bales made of wicker or hemp &c.; Tosef. Toh. XI, 16 הע' של נוצרין. Ex. R. s. 15 ע' של זיתים olive pulp.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (from its shape) 
<italic>a mass of iron</italic> used for 
<italic>ballast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 1. Makhsh. V, 7 המים העולים … ובע' וכ' (ed. Dehr. ובעיקל) water that comes up (and settles) in the hull, on the ballast or on the rudders; [Maim.: in the cavity in the hull made for the reception of drippings from the deck; cmp. עוּקָה].</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P01197">
<head-word>עֲקַלָּתוֹן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced. wds.) 
<italic>tortuousness</italic>; דרך ע' 
<italic>in a round about way, indirectly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Dem. IV, 24

<binyan>
<binyan-name> [[.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עָקַם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. עקב) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to curve, wind</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Erub. II, 20
<sup>a</sup> bot. כל מה שהפרה פושטת … הגמל עוֹקֵם וכ' whereas the cow stretches her neck out straight, the camel turns his neck. Lev. R. s. 10, v. infra. Lam. R. to II, 8 עוקם את חוטמו turns up his nose (at the bad odor).—Meil. 17
<sup>b</sup> ע' פיו ר' אליעזר וכ' R. El.… curved his mouth (pouted speaking in an undertone, v. עֲקִימָה).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to circumvent, supersede</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="P01143">עָקַב</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עִיקֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to curve, wind; to make a circuit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yoma VI, 44
<sup>b</sup> bot. שלשים … והיה מְעַקְּמוֹ וכ' the priest’s belt was thirty-two cubits long, and he wound it this way and that; Lev. R. s. 10 ועוקמו לפניו ולאחוריו (read: ועִיקְּמוֹ); Cant. R. to IV, 4 (not מעמקו). Gen. R. s. 50 (ref. to סורו, Gen. XIX, 2) אפי' איני כדאי עַקְּמוּ עלי את הדרך though I be not worthy (of your visit), go out of your way on my account; ib. עקמו עלי את הדרך כדי שלא תהיו נראים וכ' take a circuitous route in coming to me, that you may not be seen going to me. Ib. s. 32 ע' הקב"ה שתים וכ' the Lord (Bible text) uses a circumlocution of two or three words (writes two or three words where one would have been sufficient) in order to avoid the word ‘unclean’; Pes. 3
<sup>a</sup>; Lev. R. s. 26, beg.; a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מְעוּקָּם; f. מְעוּקֶּמֶת 
<italic>tortuous; tricky</italic>. Y. Erub. V, 22
<sup>d</sup> top היה הנחל מע' if the wady meandered. Tanḥ. Vaëra 4 מה הנחש הולך מע' אף המלכות מְעַקֶּמֶת דרכיה as the serpent moves in tortuous lines, so the government winds its ways; כשם שהנחש מע' אף פרעה מע' as the serpent is cunning, so is Pharaoh cunning; Ex. R. s. 9; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעַקֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to wind one’s self, be artful</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. כשיבוא להִתְעַקֵּם וכ' if he (Pharaoh) tries his tricks, go and say to Aaron &c.; Tanḥ. l. c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P01199">
<head-word>עַקְמוּמִית</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced. wds.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>curve</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 14
<sup>a</sup> עַקְמוּמִיתָהּ חוץ למבוי if the curved portion (of the beam placed over the entrance) is outside the alley. Ib. כל שאילו תינטל עקמומיתה וכ' Ms. M. if, after the curved portion is taken off, there remains a gap of less than &c. Y. ib. I, 19
<sup>a</sup> bot. והוא שתהא ע' מן הצד provided the curve is sideways; ע' שהיא מעכבת וכ' a curve which obstructs the alley. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40
<sup>a</sup> bot. דרך ע' היתה it was a tortuous road (on which he met her); Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>c</sup> top עקמומיתה (corr. acc.); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. עַקְמוּמִיּוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Erub. I, 18
<sup>c</sup> bot. אלו … דרך ע' וכ' those living on this side of the alley make use of the curves (on this side of the wall), and those living on the other side make use of the curves (on the other side) &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ambush, hiding place</italic> (by the wayside).</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. as ab. Sifré Deut. 20 אין לך דרך שאין בה ע'</plural-form> there is no highway without ambushes; Yalk. ib. 804 (
<italic>sing</italic>.). </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>crookedness of the heart, insidiousness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, 9 כתומי ולא כעַקְמִימוּתִי according to my simplicity, but not according to my insidiousness (sin).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (v. next w.) 
<italic>hump</italic>; trnsf. 
<italic>haughtiness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 59
<sup>a</sup> לא נבראו רעמים אלא לפשוט ע' שבלב (Ms. F. לפסוק עקמומיות, 
<italic>pl.</italic>; v. Rabb. R. S. a. l. note 400) the thunders were created to level (to cut off) the protuberance (protuberances) of the heart (to break man’s pride).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> (speaking to a hunchback, v. גְּבִיעָא) בעיטנא … ופשיטנא לעַקְמוּמִיתָךְ מינך Ms. K. (Ms. M. לעַקְמִימוּתָךְ, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. לעִקְמוּתָךְ) I shall kick thee and level thy hump from off thee (drive out thy conceit).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P01211">
<head-word>עָקַץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. עקב, a. Arab.</definition>
<notes> ʿaḳaṣ) [
<italic>to bend, twist</italic>; denom. עוּקָץ 
<italic>tail, point, peduncle</italic> &c.,] </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut fruit by the stalks.</italic></definition>
<notes> Peah VII, 3 ע' את כל האשכול Ms. M. if he cut an entire cluster. Snh. 41
<sup>a</sup> ע' תאנה he cut figs. B. Kam. 70
<sup>b</sup> עֲקוֹץ לך תאינה מתאינתי וכ' cut figs (to the value of the stolen object) in my fig plantation, and take possession for me of the stolen object which thou holdest; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sting, prick</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>b</sup> שעֲקָצוֹ חברבר וחיה that a lizard stung him, and he recovered. Cant. R. to I, 12 אפי' פורטענא 
<pgbrk id="pg1108" />לא ע' בם not even a flea stung them; ib. to V, 3 עָקְצָה. Ib. to II, 15 ועוֹקְצִין אותם and they pricked them (with a pin); a. fr.—Esth. R. to I, 12 (proverbial expression) רמזתו ולא נרמז עֲקָצַתּוּ ולא נעקץ she gave him a hint, and he did not heed it, she pricked him, and he did not feel the sting.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶעֱקַץ</binyan-form>
<senses>

<italic>to be stung, feel the sting</italic>, v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="P01213">
<head-word>עָקַר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. עקב)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to be curved, bent</italic>; denom. עִיקָּר 
<italic>root</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to uproot, tear loose, detach, remove; to eradicate, undo, abolish, abrogate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Hor. 14
<sup>a</sup> עוֹקֵר הרים; Snh. 24
<sup>a</sup> עוקר הרי הרים, v. הַר. Ab. III, 17 הרוח באה ועוֹקַרְתּוֹ וכ' a wind comes and uproots it and turns it &c. Pesik. Ekha, p. 123
<sup>a</sup> כל מקום שנאמר ארון עוקר דיורין ומכניס וכ' wherever 
<italic>Adon</italic> (Master) is mentioned in the Bible, it means (the landlord) that displaces tenants and imports tenants; ib. עוקר כנענים וכ' who drives out the Canaanites and brings in the Israelites. Y. Yeb. I, 2
<sup>d</sup>; ib. XIII, beg. 13
<sup>b</sup> ממאנת … לַעֲקוֹר זיקת המת she may (on arriving at majority) refuse the 
<italic>Yabam</italic>, which has the effect of annulling her relation to her deceased husband. Ib. כל עמה מודיי שהיא עוֹקֶרֶת all agree that by doing so she annuls her marriage to her deceased husband. Pes. 101
<sup>b</sup> עָקְרוּ רגליהן לצאת when they detached their feet, in order to go. Sabb. 5
<sup>a</sup> ע' ממקומו וכ' (sub. רגליו) he moved from his place and received it. Y. Bets. V, 63
<sup>a</sup> bot., v. קִיפּוּץ. Meg. 5
<sup>b</sup> בקש לעקור תשעה וכ' wanted to abolish the fast of the Ninth of Ab. Pes. 115

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to mix, confuse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Deut. 808 עָרְבוּ את העיסה (or עֵרְבוּ 
<italic>Pi.</italic>; not ערכו), v. עִיסָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to substitute, put in place of</italic>,] 
<italic>to vouch for</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to I, 4 אבותינו עוֹרְבִים אותנו let our ancestors be our surety (for our observance of the Law); Yalk. Cant. 982. Deut. R. s. 3 מבקשים אתם שנַעֲרוֹב אתכס וכ' do you want us to guarantee to you that, if you separate your tithes properly, the mice will not attack 
<pgbrk id="pg1110" />your grain any more? Ib. ע' אותן והלכו he did guarantee to them, and the mice went &c. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 5 מפני מה לא עָרַבְתָּ את וכ' why didst thou not pledge thyself for thy brother &c?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עֵירֵב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to mix</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 52
<sup>b</sup> שמואל אמר מְעָרֵב Samuel explains (המנסך ib. V, 4, v. נָסַךְ), he who mixes forbidden wine with his neighbor’s permitted wine. Koh. R. to IX, 13, a. e. המערב מים ביין וכ' who puts water into wine &c., v. גְּלַבְקְיָא. M. Kat. 8
<sup>b</sup> אין מְעָרְבִין שמחה בשמחה you must not mix one rejoicing with another (e.g. celebrate a wedding during the Festive Week); Gen. R. s. 70. Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>c</sup> עי' את האותיות if one made the letters of a word of uneven sizes (so that they are not in a line). Gen. R. s. 15 שלא לעָרֵב את האותיות he said המוציא in order not to confound the letters (by saying העולם מוציא); Y. Ber. VI, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. ראשי אותיות; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְעוּרָב; f. מְעוּרֶבֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוּרָבִים, מְעוּרָבִין; מְעוּרָבוֹת</plural-form>. Yalk. Deut. 808 וראה הפת מע' קיבר and saw that the bread was mixed with coarse flour. Erub. 27
<sup>a</sup> כשקרבי דגים מע' בהן when entrails of fish are mixed up with the brine; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 20 (in Chald. dict.) מעורב, v. עַרְבֵּב.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of עֵירוּב 2) 
<italic>to lay an ʿErub, to create a symbolical community of residence </italic>or
<italic> continuity of action</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. III, 1 מערבין לנזיר ביין you may use wine for an ʿErub for the benefit of a Nazarite. Ib. 84
<sup>b</sup>; 87
<sup>b</sup> עד שיְעָרְבוּ until they connect them symbolically by an ʿErub; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Sabb. XVI, 3 חצר המע' a court which has been made available for Sabbath movements by means of an ʿErub; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pledge</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. as ab. Esth. R. to I, 1 (ref. to בני התערבות, II Chr. XXV, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition />
<notes> שהיו מְעוּרָבוֹתֵיהֶן של אבותיהן they were the hostages for their fathers.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְעָרֵב, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְעָרֵב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be mixed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. VI, 5 דם שנ' במים if blood (which requires covering up, v. כִּיסּוּי) has been mixed with water. Tosef. Ter. V, 15 פרוסות … שנִתְעָרְבוּ וכ' if pieces of show-bread have become mixed up with a hundred times as many pieces of secular bread; Yeb. 81
<sup>b</sup> פרוסה … שנִתְעָרְבָה וכ'; Y. Orl. II, 61
<sup>d</sup> bot. Cant. R. to I, 3 מה השמן הזה אין מִתְעָרֵב … אין מִתְעָרְבִים וכ' as oil cannot be mixed with other liquids, so Israel should not be mixed with the nations of the world; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<sup>c</sup> bot ריגלוי … עַרְבוּנֵיה למיקמתיה וכ' (not ערבתיה) man’s feet are pledged to place him where he is wanted (to die); Succ. 53
<sup>a</sup> רגלוהי … אינון עַרְבִין ביה וכ'. Bekh. 48
<sup>b</sup> מכדי נכסוהי … ערבין ביה is a man’s property pledged for his personal debts (that you can seize it, even if it is sold)?; B. Bath. 174
<sup>a</sup> ניכסי … ערבין ביה Ms. M. (ed. מערבין יתיה) a man’s property is pledged for him (you can attach it without previous summons); a. e.</notes></sense>

<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 40 (Bxt. עֲ' 
<italic>Pe.</italic>; Y. עַרְבֵּיב'). Targ. Y. I Deut. VII, 23 (ed. Vien. וִיעַרְבִּ' 
<italic>Pe.</italic>; Y. II ויערבב'); a. e.—Ḥull. 6
<sup>a</sup> כמאן דע' בידים דמי it is as if he had mixed it (added leaven and spices) with his own hands. Ab. Zar. 39
<sup>b</sup> דילמא מייתי ומְעָרֵב ביה lest he bring (unclean milk) and mix it with the clean milk; a. e.—Part. pass. מְעָרַב, מְעַרַב; pl. מְעַרְבִין, מְעַרְבֵי. Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 18 (not מְעַרְבּ', מֵ'). Targ. Ex. XXX, 35 (ed. Vien. מַעֲרַב

<italic>well-mixed, seasoned</italic> (h. text מְמֻלָּח). Targ. Is. I, 22 (ed. Wil. מַעֲרָב 
<italic>Af.</italic>); a. e.—Sabb. 85
<sup>b</sup> והא קא מערבי להדי הדדי Ms. M. (ed. מִיתְעָרְבֵי בהדדי,

<notes> Targ. Y. Ex. XVI, 5 וִיעָ' (ed. Vien. ויעַ', corr. acc.).—Y. Bets. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> top אנשינן מְעָרְבָה we forgot to make ʿErub Tabshilin (v. עֵירוּב); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to vouch, be surety</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. as ab. Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 32 מְעָרַב (not מְעָרֵב).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְעָרֵב, </binyan-form>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be mixed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Josh. XXIII, 7. Targ. Y. II Deut. VII, 3 (h. text תתחתן); a. e.—Sabb. l. c., v. supra.—Ab. Zar. l. c. אי משום אִיעֲרוּבֵי shall we apprehend an admixture (of wine in the honey)? Zeb. 76
<sup>a</sup> סוף סוף איערובי מִיעֲרַב at the end it is mixed up. Ib. דאיע' when it became mixed; ib. 75
<sup>b</sup> דאִיעֲרוּב Ms. M. (ed. דאיעבד) when things have become mixed; a. e.—[Ab. Zar. l. c. ולא מיערב, read מְעָרֵב.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

VIII (ref. to Prov. VI, 1) בשעה שהזקן … עד שלא נתמנית לא היית ע' על וכ' when a man is appointed an elder, the Lord says to him, before thou wast appointed, thou wast not responsible for the community, now that thou hast been appointed &c. B. Bath. X, 7 המלוה … על ידי ע' לא יפרע מן הע' he who loans money to his neighbor through a surety, cannot collect from the surety (before having sued the debtor). Ib. 8 איזהו ע' שהוא חייב וכ' what guarantor is responsible? He who says, ‘lend him, and I shall pay thee’ (i.e. who guaranteed before the loan was consummated); a. fr.—

R. l. c. בשעה שעמדו … הביאו לי ע' טובים וכ' when the Israelites were standing before mount Sinai to receive the Law, the Lord said … bring me good sureties (to vouch for you) that you will guard it; ib. אבותיכם צריכין ע' your ancestors need sureties themselves; ib. הא ודאי ע' וכ' these (your children) are certainly good sureties, and on their account I will give you the Law; Midr. Snh. 27

<sense>

<italic>to mix up, confound, disturb</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. R. Hash. III, end 59
<sup>a</sup> עי' את המזלות he (Moses) confounded the order of the planets. Cant. R. to I, 9 היו מְעַרְבְּבִין אותם they (the lightnings) confused their ranks; ib.; Mekh. B’shall. s. 5 עִרְבְּבָן הממן, v. הָמַם. Tanḥ. Vaëra 5 (ref. to יהולל, Koh. VII, 7) מערבבין אותו, v. עָסַק. Lev. R. 
<pgbrk id="pg1112" />s. 20 אם אני … הריני מְעַרְבֵּב שמחת וכ' if I put him to death now, I shall disturb my daughter’s wedding feast. Koh. R. to II, 2 [read:] ועִירְבַּבְתִּים I confounded them, v. הוּל. R. Hash. 16
<sup>b</sup> כדי לעַרְבֵּב השטן in order to confound (silence) the accuser; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְעיּרְבָּב; f. מְעוּרְבֶּבֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוּרְבָּבִין; מְעוּרְבָּבוֹת</plural-form>. Tanḥ. Aḥăré 1 (ref. to Koh. II, 2) מה מע' שחוק של וכ' how confounded (mad) is the laughter of the gentiles in their theatres and circuses! Ib. מה מע' שחוק ששחקה מדת הדין על דור וכ' how the laughter was confounded which Divine Justice laughed over the generation of the flood, i.e. how the divine indulgence towards the sinful generation was abused! Ib. מה מע' … עם אלישבע וכ' how the rejoicing was disturbed which Divine Justice allowed Elisheba &c.; Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 170
<sup>a</sup> מה מעורבב הוא השמחה (corr. acc.); Koh. R. l. c. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 אין נבוכים אלא מע' 
<italic>n’bokhim</italic> (Ex. XIV, 3) means perplexed. Snh. 42
<sup>a</sup> כדי שלא … מע' that they should not leave the court in perplexity (v. עָמַם). Ex. R. s. 11 חיות ועופות מע' various kinds of beasts and birds, v. עָרוֹב; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> עֲרָבִים

<xref rid="A02974">אֲרַבְתָּא</xref>)

<italic>the boughs of the willow attached to the Lulab</italic>, and 
<italic>the willow branch used in the Temple in procession around the altar during the Succoth festival</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> עשר נטיעות ע' ניסוך וכ' the law concerning ten young trees (Shebi. I, 6), the custom of the procession with the willow branch, and that of the water libation are Sinaitic traditions (v. הֲלָכָה). Ib. ע' קנה שלה וכ' the willow (fit for the religious ceremony) has a red stem, its leaves are elongated, and their outlines plain (not curved or serried). Ib. IV, 1 לולב וע' וכ' for the ceremony of the Lulab and of the willow branch there are six or eventually seven days. Ib. 3 יום שביעי של ע' the seventh day of Succoth which is the special day for the ʿĂrabah (= יום הושענא, v. הוֹשַׁעְנָא); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲרָבוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. III, 4 שלשה הדסים ושתי ע' in the Lulab there must be three myrtle boughs and two willow boughs; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P01321">
<head-word>עֶרְוָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="P01305"> עָרָה I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>nakedness, shame; unchastity, lewdness, obscenity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to I, 2 מה מים מכסים עֶרְוָתוֹ … עֶרְוָתָן as water covers the nakedness of the sea, … so (study of) the Law covers up the nakedness (atones for the sins) of Israel. Ber. 24
<sup>b</sup> לבו רואה את הע' his heart sees the nakedness, i.e. there is no garment (girdle &c.) separating the upper part of the body from the lower. Ib. 24
<sup>a</sup> משום ע', v. עֲגָבָה. Ib. קול באשה ע' hearing a woman’s voice is indecency (you must not read the Sh’mʿa while a woman is singing within your heaving); שער באשה ע' the sight of woman’s hair is an impropriety (with regard to reading the Sh’mʿa). Gitt. IX, 10 לא יגרש … דבר ע' a man must not divorce his wife, unless he have found in her something improper (v. Deut. XXIV, 1). Ib. 90
<sup>a</sup> (interpret. ערות דבר, Deut. l. c.) אם נאמר ערות … הייתי אומר משום 
<pgbrk id="pg1115" />ע' תצא משום דבר לא תצא if the text had 
<italic>ʿervath</italic> (meaning 
<italic>ʿervah</italic>) without 
<italic>dabar</italic>, I might have thought, for scandalous conduct she is to be dismissed, for ‘something’ (any other cause) she must not be dismissed. Ib. לא מצא בה לא ע' ולא דבר if he found in her neither indecency nor any other fault. Ib. 64
<sup>a</sup> a. fr. אין דבר שבע' פחות משנים any act in which purity of sexual life is concerned (marriage, divorce &c.) requires no less than two witnesses. Ab. III, 13 שחוק … מרגילין (את האדם) לע' merriment and light-mindedness make man familiar with licentiousness; a. v. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>incest</italic>, trnsf. 
<italic>ʿervah, a woman forbidden to a man</italic> (
<italic>and vice versa</italic>) 
<italic>on account of consanguinity</italic>. Yeb. 3
<sup>b</sup> מה אחות אשה מיוחדת שהיא ע' … אף כל שהיא ע' וכ' as the sister of a man’s (living) wife who is singled out (Lev. XVIII, 18) as an 
<italic>ʿervah</italic>, with the punishment of extinction in case of wilfulness, and of a sin-offering in case of mistake, may not be taken in a levirate marriage, so no woman that is a forbidden relation … may be taken &c. Ib. 13
<sup>a</sup> צרות ע' the rivals of a woman forbidden on account of consanguinity; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲרָיוֹת</plural-form> (fr. עֶרְיָה). Keth. 13
<sup>b</sup>, v. אֶפִּיטְרוֹפּוֹס.—גילוי ע', v. גִּילּוּי. Yeb. I, 2 היתה בתו או אחת מכל הע' האלו וכ' if a man’s daughter or any other of those (above mentioned) relations was married to his brother. Ib. 3
<sup>b</sup> כל הע' האמורות בתורה all forbidden relations named in the Torah. Ib. I, 3 שש ע' חמורות מאלו six relations more rigorously forbidden than these. Meg. IV, 9, v. כָּנָה; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup> זה המטעים וכ', v. טָעַם; Tanḥ. Mishp. 6. Sot. l. c. במי שמשים עצמו ע' Var. in Rashi, v. next w.; a. fr.—Pesik. Shimʿu, p. 118
<sup>b</sup>, sq. (in Chald. dict.) לית עיסקא דע' מהלך עם שטיא the sane has no business to walk with the fool; (Yalk. Jer. 265 דעָרִים).—

<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ps. XXXVI, 7) אלו בני אדם שהן ע' בדעת וכ' that means those men who are clever in knowledge and yet conduct themselves humbly like a domestic animal; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="P01326">
<head-word>עָרוֹם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="P01325">preced.</xref>; cmp. עָרָה) 
<italic>stripped, naked, bare.</italic></definition>
<notes> Dem. I, 4 מפרישין אותו ע' ובין וכ' Y. ed. a. Ms. M. (ed. בין, incorr.) you may separate the priest’s gift there from without being dressed (because it requires no benediction), and at twilight (on the eve of the Sabbath); Sabb. 23
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 14
<sup>a</sup> האוחז ס"ת ע' נקבר ע' he who handles a naked scroll of the Law (touches it directly with his bare hand), will he buried naked, expl. ע' בלא אותה מצוה bare of the merit of that act (of studying or of rolling and dressing it). Tosef. Keth. VI, 7 פסק … שיעמד ע' וילבישנה (not וילבשנו) if he agreed with his son-in-law that he will go naked (deprive himself, if necessary) and dress her, אין אומ' יעמד ע' וילבישנה וכ' (not וילבישנו) we do not say, let him become destitute, and he must dress her (make the outfit for her), but he (her father) must cover her as is proper for her; Y. ib. VI, 30
<sup>d</sup>. Sot. 21
<sup>b</sup> (play on ערמה, Prov. VIII, 12) אין … אלא במי שמעמיד עצמו ע' עליהן the words of the Law remain only with him who makes himself destitute for their sake (who sacrifices comforts for them); (Var. quot. in Rashi: שמשים עצמו עָרוּם עליה who makes himself cunning about it, i.e. goes to work deliberately, studies systematically); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲרוּמִּים, עֲרוּמִּין</plural-form>. Snh. 90
<sup>b</sup> כשהן עומדין עומדין ע' וכ' when they (the dead) rise, will they rise naked or dressed? Yeb. 63
<sup>b</sup> אנשי … שמהלכין ע' בשוק those of Barbaria … who walk naked in the street; Sifré Deut. 320; a. fr.—
<italic>Fem</italic>. עֲרוּמָּה. Keth. 111
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. l. c. ומה חיטה שנקברה ע' וכ' if the wheat-grain, which is buried naked, comes forth wrapped in many dresses, how much more will the righteous dead rise &c. Ib. VI, 3 אין האשה נסקלת ע' a woman convict must not be stoned (executed) undressed. Meg. 12
<sup>b</sup> ובלבד שתהא ע' provided she (Vashti) will appear undressed. Snh. 75
<sup>a</sup> ימות ולא תעמוד לפניו ע' let him (the love-sick man) die, but she must not stand undressed before him. Keth. VI, 5 פסק להכניסה ע' if the father made an agreement that he (the bridegroom) will take her to his house without the customary outfit; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲרוּמּוֹת</plural-form>. Meg. l. c. מפשיטתן ע' (not מפשיטן) she forced them to appear undressed; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup> (play on מע̇ר̇ות, I Sam. XVII, 23) שהכל הע̇ר̇ו באמו all the world had taken liberties with his mother; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>Pi</italic></notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>עֵירָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to intermix</italic> (of liquids), 
<italic>pour; to interweave, intertwine.</italic></definition>
<notes> Yoma V, 4 עי' דם הפר לתוך וכ' he poured the blood of the bullock to that of the goat, and put the full bowl in the empty one; expl. ib. 58
<sup>a</sup> עי' מזרק מלא וכ' he poured the contents of the filled bowl into the empty bowl … in order to mix them thoroughly. Y. ib. V, 42
<sup>d</sup> top (interch. with בָּלַל a. עָרַב). Y. Maasr. I, end, 49
<sup>b</sup> לעָרוֹת וכ' to pour into &c. (interch. with להַעֲרוֹת, 
<italic>Hif.</italic>); Y. Sabb. III, 6
<sup>b</sup>. Nidd. X, 6 היתה מְעָרָה מים לפסח was permitted to pour water from vessel to vessel for Passover purposes (to wash the Passover meat without touching the water). Ab. Zar. V, 7 המְעָרֶה מכלי אל כלי if a Jew pours wine from one vessel into another (held by a gentile), את שעי' ממנו מותר the wine remaining in the vessel from which he poured is permitted; a. fr.—Sifra K’dosh., Par. 2, ch. V עי' כל הפרשה כולה לכי וכ' the writer intended to join the whole paragraph (concerning emancipation) to ‘for she has not been set free’ (Lev. XIX, 20), to intimate that emancipation is consummated by a document only; (Gitt. 39
<sup>b</sup> אוֹרְעָה וכ' (fr. אָרַע I) the whole paragraph has been joined &c. B. Bath. 113
<sup>b</sup> אורעה … להיות דין, v. אָרַע II, a. corr. acc.) Y. Kidd. I, 58
<sup>d</sup> bot. (ref. to Deut. XXV, 5) ת"ל ויבמה עי' הפרשה כולה לייבום וכ' the text says, 
<italic>v’yibb’mah</italic> (‘and thus he shall be her levir’); the whole paragraph is connected with 
<italic>yibbum</italic> (the word ויבמה), intimating that marital connection only consummates the levirate marriage; Y. Yeb. II, beg. 3
<sup>c</sup> עודה (Rabad to Sifra l. c. quotes עורה, corr. acc.). Y. Snh. VII, 24
<sup>d</sup> עֵרָה את כל וכ' the whole paragraph depends on the word 
<italic>mother</italic>.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מְעוּרֶה; f. מְעוּרָה; 
<plural-form>pl. מְעוּרִים, מְעוּרִין; מְעוּרוֹת</plural-form>
<italic>intertwined, interwoven; mixed up</italic>. T’bul Yom III, 1 אוכל שנפרס ומע' מקצת if an eatable part of a fruit is broken off but partly hangs on (is not entirely severed). Ukts. III, 8 יחור של … ומע' בקליפה a shoot of a fig tree which is torn off but is still attached to the tree by the rind; Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. I, 13. Yoma 54
<sup>a</sup> הכרובים שהיו מע' זה בזה the cherubs (in the Temple) whose bodies were intertwisted with one another. Ib. sq. (expl. כמער איש וליות, I Kings VII, 36) כאיש המע' בלויה שלו like a man embracing his companion (wife). Ḥull. 127
<sup>b</sup> ומע' בחוט השערה attached by a hair’s breadth. Bets. 7
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="P01375">
<head-word>עָרַךְ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to connect, join</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to range, arrange, place in order</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yoma II, end, 40
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Lev. I, 8, a. 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> כהן אחד עוֹרֵךְ וכ' one priest places two limbs on the altar &c.; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab.</definition>
<notes>, Par. 4, ch. VI. Gen. R. s. 78 יש בי כח לעֲרוֹךְ תפלה (Yalk. ib. 133 לסדר) I have strength to offer prayer; יש בי כח לערוך מלחמה I have strength to give battle. Yalk. l. c. וע' מלחמה כנגדו gave him battle. Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 6 ואֶעֱרוֹךְ לפניכם שלחן I will set a table before you (in the hereafter), v. infra. Ned. 20
<sup>b</sup> עָרַכְתִּי לו שלחן והפכו I prepared a table for him, but he upset it (euphem. for unnatural gratification); a. e. [In Talm. mostly סדר.]—עוֹרְכֵי הדיינין (= עורכי דין לפני הדיינין) those who arrange arguments before the judges, 
<italic>pleaders, advocates</italic>, who advise their clients what to say or not to say before court. Ab. I, 8 אל תעש עצמך כע' הד' do not make thyself to be like legal advisers, i.e. be careful as judge not to suggest an advice to one of the litigants; Y. B. Bath. IX, 17
<sup>a</sup> top כעֹרְכֵי; Y. Keth. IV, 29
<sup>a</sup> bot. אל תעש עצמך כע' הד' שלא לגלות וכ' do not make thyself to be like &c., that is, you must not reveal to an individual his case (how to argue). Bab. ib. 52
<sup>b</sup>; 86
<sup>a</sup> עשינו עצמינו כע' ד' we have made ourselves to be like &c. (I ought not to have suggested an advice).—Part. pass. עָרוּךְ; f. עְרוּכָה &c. Sabb. 119
<sup>b</sup> וכשבא לביתו ומצא נר דלוק ושלחן ע' וכ' when he comes home and finds the lamp lighted, the table set and the couch spread, the good angel says &c.; a. e.—2) (cmp. Syr. ערך, P. Sm. 2990) 
<italic>to work dough</italic> (contrad. to לוּשׁ); 
<italic>to roll, shape</italic> &c. Pes. III, 4 אחת לשה ואחת עוֹרֶכֶת וכ' one woman kneads, another works and shapes the dough, and a third one bakes. Ab. Zar. IV, 9 לא לשין ולא עוֹרְכִין עמו you must not knead nor work and shape dough with him. Neg. II, 4 כעוֹרֶכֶת in the position of a woman working dough; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Erub. 54
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to ערוכה וכ', II Sam. XXIII, 5) אם ע' … משתמרת וכ' if the Law is worked into thy two hundred and forty-eight limbs, it will be preserved &c. Midr. Till. to Ps. XIV [read:] פת לושה ופת ע' kneaded (common) bread and well-worked bread; Yalk. ib. 662 עריכה (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶעֱרִיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to place side by side</italic>; cmp. נָקַשׁ 
<italic>Hif.</italic>] 
<italic>to compare; to value</italic>; esp. (v. Lev. XXVII, 2-13) 
<italic>to dedicate the value of a person or of an animal unfit for the altar</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. I, 1 הכל מַעֲרִיכִין ונֶעֱרָכִין all persons are fit to dedicate or to be the subjects of dedication. Ib. נֶעֱרָךְ אבל לא מַעֲרִיךְ may be the subject of dedication, but cannot dedicate (his vow is invalid). Ib. VI, 5 המעריך את עצמו he who dedicates his own value. Tanḥ. l. c. [read:] אתם מעריכין לפני את נפשותיכם … מעריכת גיהנם you value before me your lives, and I shall save you from the range of Gehenna (v. עֲרִיכָה), and set &c. (v. supra); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶעֱרַךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>

<entry id="P01377">
<head-word>עֵרֶךְ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>order, arrangement</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. 22
<sup>b</sup> שעֶרְכָּהּ של ארץ ישראל הוא because it (the Book of Joshua) contains the arrangement of the Land of Israel.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲרָכִים,</plural-form> constr. עֶרְכֵי. Cant. R. to VI, 4; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 7
<sup>a</sup> sq. שש ע' המשנה, v. מִשְׁנָה.—ע' המלחמה 
<italic>order of battle, arrangements proclaimed before the battle</italic> (v. מַעַרְכִים). Y. Sot. VIII, beg. 22
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Mish. ib. 6) אבל בע' המ' מספקין וכ' but in connection with the proclamation of the regulations of battle (the Mishnah says only), ‘they have to supply water &c.’ Ib. אף בע' המ' כן the same is the case with ordinances of battle (they must 
<pgbrk id="pg1119" />be proclaimed in Hebrew). Bab. ib. 43
<sup>b</sup> אין חוזרין עליו מע' המ' they are not entitled to leave the army on that account. Ib. 44
<sup>b</sup>; Men. 36
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>valuation, assessment, value of a person or animal dedicated to the sanctuary; vow of value</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. 7
<sup>b</sup> ואמר עֶרְכִּי עלי if he says, I vow my own value. Ib. IV, 1 הע' בזמן הע' the valuation is regulated by the time of the vow (irrespective of the value at the time of paying the vow); ib. 4 נותן כזמן הע' he pays according to the value at the time of the vow. Ib. נותן ע' זקן he pays the value of an old man (Lev. XXVII, 7); ע' ילד the value of a child (ib. 6); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. עֲרָכִים, עֲרָכִין</plural-form>. Ib. II, 1 אין בע' וכ' (Var. נֶעֱרָכִין, v. עָרַךְ) in vows of value nothing is valued at less than a Selʿa &c.; ib. 7
<sup>b</sup> כל ע' שאתה מעריך וכ' all values which you assess shall be no less than &c. Ib. IV, 1 והע' בנערך the vows of value are regulated by the condition of the person whose value is vowed. Ib. III, 1 יש בע' להקל וכ' in the laws regulating the dedication of values there is a lenient and a rigorous side. Ib. 2
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. כל שישנו בדמים ישנו בע' … אינו בע' he whose person has a value, can vow the value of a person or an animal, but he whose person has no value cannot. Kerith. 13
<sup>b</sup> דמין וע', v. דָּמִים. Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 6 פרשת ע' the section treating of vows of value. Ib. בזכות הע' אני מציל וכ' as a reward for your offerings of values, I will save you &c.; a. fr.—
<italic>ʿĂrakhin</italic>, name of a treatise of Mishnah, Tosefta and Talmud Babli, of the Order of Kodashim.—[ערכין, Gitt. 44
<sup>a</sup> Ar., v. עַרְכִי.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>ʿorlah</italic> (the word
<italic>ʿărelim</italic>) is used only as a general name for gentiles, v. עָרֵל. Ib. מאוסה (היא ה)ע' שנתגנו וכ' uncircumcision is detestable, for it is applied to the wicked as a reproach (with ref. to Jer. IX, 25); a. fr.—

<sup>a</sup>; Sabb. 135

<italic>that which is to be rejected</italic>,]

<italic>ʿorlah</italic>. Ib. 6 נטיעה של ע' a young tree subject to the law of 
<italic>ʿorlah</italic>. Ib. 7 שרף הע' resin of a young tree; a. fr.—Tosef. Ter. V, 9, a. fr. עוֹרְלָה.—
<italic>ʿOrlah</italic>, name of a treatise of Mishnah, Tosefta and Talmud Y’rushalmi, of the Order of Z’raʿim.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
